name: chat-with-your-data-copilot
description: Chartwise — connect a CSV or database, ask questions in plain English, get a chart + the generated SQL.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n engine,server,client -c cyan,magenta,green "node scripts/engine.mjs --reload" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.start: npm run build && concurrently -k -n engine,server -c cyan,magenta "node scripts/engine.mjs" "npm --prefix server start"
